passages.text: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
The elders were the leaders of the people of Israel.
On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron.
Moses called Aaron’s sons.
Moses called the elders of Israel.
Moses gathered them together.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י קָרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו וּלְזִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and present them before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Moses gave Aaron instructions from the LORD.
Moses told Aaron to take a young bull.
The young bull must be for a sin offering.
Moses told Aaron to take a ram.
The ram must be for a burnt offering.
Both the young bull and the ram must be without blemish.
Aaron must present the young bull and the ram before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַח־ לְ֠ךָ עֵ֣גֶל בֶּן־ בָּקָ֧ר לְחַטָּ֛את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וְהַקְרֵ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without blemish—for a burnt offering, an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He gave them instructions from the LORD.
He said, “Take a male goat for a sin offering.
Take a calf for a burnt offering.
Take a lamb for a burnt offering.
The calf and the lamb must each be one year old.
The calf and the lamb must have no blemish.
Take an ox for a peace offering.
Take a ram for a peace offering.
Offer the ox and the ram as a sacrifice before the LORD.
Bring a grain offering mixed with oil.
Do these things today.
Today the LORD will appear to you.”
passages.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר קְח֤וּ שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּים֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְעֵ֨גֶל וָכֶ֧בֶשׂ בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִ֖ם לְעֹלָֽה׃ וְשׁ֨וֹר וָאַ֜יִל לִשְׁלָמִ֗ים לִזְבֹּ֙חַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָ֖ה בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן כִּ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites obeyed Moses.
They took the offerings Moses commanded.
They brought them to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
All the people gathered together.
They came close and stood before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֗וּ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He said, “The LORD has given you a command.
You must do what the LORD has commanded.
If you obey, the glory of the LORD will appear to you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה זֶ֧ה הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְיֵרָ֥א אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Approach the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and for the people. And sacrifice the people’s offering to make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest.
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Moses said, “Go to the altar.
Offer your sin offering.
Offer your burnt offering.
Make atonement for yourself.
Make atonement for the people.
Offer the people’s sacrifice.
Make atonement for them.
Do everything as the LORD has commanded.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְרַ֤ב אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־ חַטָּֽאתְךָ֙ וְאֶת־ עֹ֣לָתֶ֔ךָ וְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וּבְעַ֣ד הָעָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֤ן הָעָם֙ וְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּֽעֲדָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron walked to the altar.
Aaron killed the calf.
The calf was a sin offering.
Aaron offered the calf for his own sins.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרַ֥ב אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּשְׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ עֵ֥גֶל הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and applied it to the horns of the altar. And he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
The sons of Aaron brought blood to Aaron.
Aaron dipped his finger in the blood.
Aaron put the blood on the horns of the altar.
Aaron poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.original: וַ֠יַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֶת־ הַדָּם֮ אֵלָיו֒ וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל אֶצְבָּעוֹ֙ בַּדָּ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־ הַדָּ֣ם יָצַ֔ק אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron took the fat from the sin offering.
He took the kidneys from the sin offering.
He took the lobe of the liver from the sin offering.
He placed them on the altar.
He burned them on the altar.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֨לֶב וְאֶת־ הַכְּלָיֹ֜ת וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֤רֶת מִן־ הַכָּבֵד֙ מִן־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את הִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: But he burned up the flesh and the hide outside the camp.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron received the flesh and the hide from the sin offering.
Aaron burned the flesh outside the camp.
Aaron burned the hide outside the camp.
Aaron used fire to burn them.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְאֶת־ הָע֑וֹר שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Then Aaron slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he sprinkled it on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron slaughtered the burnt offering.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him.
Aaron sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the priest.
People brought Aaron the burnt offering.
They brought it to him in pieces.
They also brought him the head.
Aaron burned the pieces and the head on the altar.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָעֹלָ֗ה הִמְצִ֧יאוּ אֵלָ֛יו לִנְתָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ הָרֹ֑אשׁ וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: He washed the entrails and the legs and burned them atop the burnt offering on the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron washed the entrails.
Aaron washed the legs.
Aaron burned the entrails and the legs on top of the burnt offering.
Aaron burned them on the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֶת־ הַקֶּ֖רֶב וְאֶת־ הַכְּרָעָ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עַל־ הָעֹלָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

passages.text: Aaron then presented the people’s offering. He took the male goat for the people’s sin offering, slaughtered it, and offered it for sin like the first one.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron presented the offering of the people.
He took the male goat.
This goat was for the people’s sin offering.
He slaughtered the goat.
He offered it as a sin offering.
He did this just as he had done with the first sin offering.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת קָרְבַּ֣ן הָעָ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֥הוּ וַֽיְחַטְּאֵ֖הוּ כָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: He presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron presented the burnt offering.
Aaron offered the burnt offering as the law commanded.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֖ב אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲשֶׂ֖הָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Next he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron presented the grain offering.
He took a handful of the grain offering.
He burned the handful on the altar.
He did this in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֮ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָה֒ וַיְמַלֵּ֤א כַפּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ מִלְּבַ֖ד עֹלַ֥ת הַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram as the people’s peace offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he sprinkled it on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
He acted on behalf of the people.
Aaron slaughtered the ox.
Aaron slaughtered the ram.
These animals were for the people’s peace offering.
Aaron’s sons brought the blood to Aaron.
Aaron sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֤ט אֶת־ הַשּׁוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ הָאַ֔יִל זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֑ם וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֶת־ הַדָּם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: They also brought the fat portions from the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver— and placed these on the breasts. Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar, but he waved the breasts and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses had commanded.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The people brought him the fat portions from the ox and the ram.
These fat portions included the fat tail.
They also included the fat covering the entrails.
They included the kidneys.
They included the lobe of the liver.
They placed all these fat portions on the breasts of the animals.
Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar.
Aaron took the breasts and the right thigh.
He waved the breasts and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD.
Aaron did this as Moses had commanded.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֖ים מִן־ הַשּׁ֑וֹר וּמִן־ הָאַ֔יִל הָֽאַלְיָ֤ה וְהַֽמְכַסֶּה֙ וְהַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְיֹתֶ֖רֶת הַכָּבֵֽד׃ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַל־ הֶחָז֑וֹת וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַחֲלָבִ֖ים הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃ וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָז֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֔ין הֵנִ֧יף אַהֲרֹ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having made the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offering, he stepped down.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron lifted his hands toward the people.
Aaron blessed the people.
Aaron had finished making the sin offering.
Aaron had finished making the burnt offering.
Aaron had finished making the peace offering.
Aaron stepped down from the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ יָדוֹ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֑ם וַיֵּ֗רֶד מֵעֲשֹׂ֧ת הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְהָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Moses and Aaron then entered the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest.
Moses and Aaron entered the Tent of Meeting.
They came out from the Tent of Meeting.
They blessed the people.
The glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD showed His power to the people.
Fire came out from the presence of the LORD.
The fire burned up the burnt offering on the altar.
The fire also burned up the fat portions on the altar.
All the people saw this happen.
The people shouted for joy.
The people fell facedown.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֑ים וַיַּ֤רְא כָּל־ הָעָם֙ וַיָּרֹ֔נּוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
